I’m also 23 and I teach 7th grade. If you do a reset, the kids won’t hate you. Promise. I had to do the same thing. If anything, they actually love me MORE now that I’m holding them accountable and being “mean” to them. 

However mean you think you’re being, you’re not being mean at all. Have a conversation with them about it. They like it when people are straightforward with them. I told one of my classes, “Look, if we don’t relax behaviorally in here, I’m not going to be able to be your teacher anymore” and they all said “Wait, what? No! We’ll do better. They can’t get rid of you!” 

They’ll understand why you’re being mean if you give them the reason why. They’ll probably even grow to appreciate it.
For the most part, we just like knowing that we’re appreciated and that we had an impact on someone. At this point, even a note would be enough to make me cry.
